summary.text: Carl Metzgar is a Republican state representative from Somerset County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 69 since December 2008 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney and lifelong Somerset County resident, he is the Republican chairman of the House Consumer Protection, Technology and Utilities Committee.

paragraphs.text: Metzgar was born and raised on a farm in Allegheny Township, Somerset County, and graduated from Berlin Brothersvalley High School in 2000, according to his official biography.

He graduated cum laude from Frostburg State University with degrees in political science and criminal justice, and earned a law degree from Duquesne University School of Law, where he received the Judge Manning Award for trial advocacy.
He practices as an attorney in Somerset and Bedford counties.
Metzgar was appointed Republican chairman of the Consumer Protection, Technology and Utilities Committee for the 2025-26 session.
His biography says he has championed legislation to reduce government control and lower taxes, and has supported measures to increase penalties for assaults against corrections staff.
Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in the general election for the district.
